what: A byte-for-byte DEV COPY of REAL nba-sim-v1-coherent engine output (not a synthetic fixture: it carries no fixture flag). Kept here only so the unlinked NBA Simulation Theater dev route can be built and reviewed before experimental-v1 artifacts are committed under data/. Read only; never edited. The theater refuses it unless this file's sha256 matches.
source: scratchpad/nba-v1-time.json (session scratchpad), built on branch claude/nba-sim-v1-coherent (PR #1134, unmerged) with --now 2026-10-19T05:40Z from committed rosters/injuries
knownDeviation: Sample player minutes are serialized at 0.01 resolution, so a side's Σ minutes reads 239.98–240.02 (265 ± 0.02 with one OT) instead of exactly 240 + 25·OT; the engine checks the exact sum before rounding (invariants.violations = 0). The theater accepts this ONLY within the rounding bound (0.005 × players with minutes) and shows it as a MINUTES_ROUNDED note.
